doc: stages/writers.copc.rst Options: 'system_id  String identifying the system that created this LAS file. [Default: "PDAL"]', 'software_id  String identifying the software that created this LAS file.', 'creation_doy  Number of the day of the year (January 1 == 1) this file is being created.', 'creation_year  Year (Gregorian) this file is being created.', 'global_encoding  Various indicators to describe the data ... Note that PDAL will always set bit four when creating LAS version 1.4 output. [Default: 0]', 'project_id  UID reserved for the user [Default: Nil UID]'. Asserted through `pdal info --metadata` on the written file, each value chosen distinct from its default, and `global_encoding` asserted as the documented value with bit four set (1 | 16 == 17).
